messages:
alex: Quick sync — I want to propose "Allocation Guardrails" as the Dedicated Capacity MVP. Focus: reserved pools, per-tenant quotas, soft-burst credits, and a simple autoscale fallback. Need tradeoffs and a launch checklist.

maria: +1. Two big tradeoffs: utilization vs predictability, and billing complexity vs simplicity. For MVP I suggest conservative defaults so we don’t break SLAs.

jamal: From runtime perspective: we can ship token-bucket burst credits per tenant and a soft-eviction path. Implementation estimate: ~3 wks for core logic + 1 week for rollout tooling.

sarah: Sales signal — top enterprise asks: burst carryover and explicit burst SLAs. We should NOT promise carryover in MVP (negotiation pain).

rachel: Ops note — required for launch: observability per-pool (latency, denied requests, burst consumption), per-tenant billing export, and oncall runbook for preemption events.

product-ops: Proposal for MVP defaults: reserved_pool = committed_RPS, soft_burst = 2x monthly token budget, eviction_grace = 30s, fallback_model = best-effort cheaper variant. Thoughts?

jamal: Those defaults look safe. One runtime caveat: fallback_model needs model-compat checks (tokenizer/version). We'll add a compatibility matrix to config.

alex: Good call. For scope we should explicitly cut: no carryover, no customer-configurable burst tiers in MVP, no per-session custom quotas. Keep admin UI minimal (toggle + numeric fields).

maria: Launch gating checklist draft: 1) core token-bucket + enforcement in runtime; 2) per-pool metrics in console; 3) billing export mapping (reserved vs burst) to csv; 4) contract language template for burst behavior; 5) canary rollout plan and rollback.

rachel: Ops items — add alerts: burst_utilization > 80% sustained 5m, preempt_evictions > 0.5% requests per pool, and fallback_rate > 1% for 1m. Also need synthetic tests that simulate tenant surge.

jamal: Canary plan: enable for internal customers (alpha) -> selected enterprise sandbox -> gradual % rollout across regions. Devops bot can schedule a Friday 2am PT deploy window for the first canary.

devops-bot: Deploy window booked: Fri 02:00 PT, target cluster "canary-dedicated-1". Reminder: follow rollback checklist.

alex: OK owners: jamal = runtime impl, rachel = observability + runbooks, product-ops = contract + customer comms, maria = prioritization sign-off, alex = launch decision. Target: ship internal alpha in 4w, public beta in 10w.

sarah: One more thing — pricing: finance wants a simple surcharge for burst usage in MVP. Suggest a flat per-token premium for burst consumption. We can refine later.

maria: Agreed. MVP pricing: per-token for reserved usage (normal) and flat premium for burst. Document in pricing doc and make sure billing export aligns.

alex: Next steps: product-ops will prototype contract language and comms draft by EOD Tue. Jamal to share PR for token-bucket policy design by EOD Wed. Rachel to list required dashboards and alerts in the runbook doc by Thu.

product-ops: Noted. I'll open a PM Jira with these owners and link here.

alex: Thanks — if no objections by EOD Monday we lock scope and start sprint planning. :thumbsup:
